title: Manifest lacks id, screenshots and a logged-out-friendly start_url
persona: New Android Chrome visitor wanting to install the PWA
expected: Stable `id`, `screenshots` (Chrome rich install UI on Android), start_url that works for any visitor.
actual: Manifest has name, short_name, scope /, start_url /slate, standalone, portrait, colours, 3 icons - but no `id` (identity falls back to start_url, so changing start_url later re-installs), no screenshots/lang/categories. A visitor who installs before signing in launches into /slate -> /login?next=%2Fslate (acceptable, but note).
